scope: Before the authorized twenty-source batch110 intake; hashes bind all186records and999assets.

top_level.audience: Electrical engineering students preparing for system chip validation interviews
notes: Local preparation collection requested by Harel; publish to the website at the end of preparation.

Standing instruction updated by Harel: on every new question, automatically save its full prompt/image, topic tags, reported companies, three progressive hints, and a complete justified proposed solution with verification.
Preparation/storage is separate from disclosure: reveal one hint per request and show the full solution in chat only when requested. Do not wait for another request to author and save the solution.

Do not track chat hint requests, disclosure counts or personal progress in this bank. Use conversation context to select the next hint. Existing chat tracking fields are historical only and must not be imported as website user progress. Future website usage tracking belongs in separate per-user records.

Always preserve every supplied image/diagram under sources and link it from the question. Preserve generated solution diagrams under diagrams and link them as proposed-solution assets; never keep a clipboard temp path as the sole copy.
Solutions are presented as proposed solutions, with explicit assumptions and justified optimality criteria.
Preparing for Marvell does not establish company attribution for any question.
Question fields follow example_question/questions.json; preparation metadata may extend each item.
Includes answer keys when populated; do not serve this entire file as a public frontend asset.
